title: Create localStorage progress hook for anonymous users
description: Create a useAnonymousProgress() hook that stores all progress data in localStorage for unauthenticated users. This enables anonymous users to practice and see their progress persist across page refreshes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Hook generates songscript_visitor_id UUID if not exists
Hook stores progress in songscript_anonymous_progress key
Schema mirrors Convex tables: wordProgress, lineProgress, songProgress, practiceLog, wishlist, preferences
Anonymous user can mark words as learned, data persists on page refresh
Anonymous user can mark lines as learned, data persists on page refresh
Corrupted localStorage gracefully resets to empty state
All data operations are synchronous (no async needed for localStorage)

technicalNotes: Use Zod or manual validation for localStorage reads
Export types that match Convex schema for easy migration
Include helper functions: getWordProgress, setWordLearned, getLineProgress, setLineLearned, etc.
testingNotes: Unit test: validates corrupted JSON returns empty state
Unit test: generates visitorId on first access
Unit test: persists and retrieves word progress correctly
Unit test: persists and retrieves line progress correctly
